chunks: Safwan ibn Yahya asked Abu al-Hasan al-Ridha عليه السلام.
About a man who has a young wife, then abstains from approaching her for months or a year, not intending to harm her; some hardship befalls them. Is he sinful in that?
He عليه السلام said: "If he leaves her for four months, he is sinful after that, unless it is with her permission."

key_terms.مُصِيبَةٌ: a hardship or affliction affecting them

ai.seo_question: How long may a husband abstain from intimacy with his wife before it becomes sinful in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a husband's abstention from marital relations with his young wife. It states that if he refrains for four months, he becomes sinful thereafter unless the wife consents, indicating the recognition of her marital rights.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4415 - Safwan ibn Yahya asked Imam Ali ibn Musa Ar-Ridha (as),

about a man who has a young wife and refrains from approaching her for months or even a year, not intending to harm her but due to some hardship or difficulty they are facing. Is he considered sinful for this?
The Imam (as) replied: "If he refrains from her for four months, he is sinful after that unless it is with her consent."
